question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

QZCT : JAXG :: MRDY : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1e96d51b86d15421868a13329a263f32ed0009588559b082c8ac26d64b3fe09.png] 

Logic : Immediate opposite letter according to English alphabetic series.

​So, 

 
• QZCT : JAXG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f58cf3c81cce06a10beff444cd8b22442de92671581ce55428f42b72d2cc81a.png] ​

Similarly,

 
• MRDY : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffd0ddce899d1630d0525addd371ec44e82688df32d80b075c1fabc071f6f1d9.png] ​

Hence, **"****NIWB"** is the correct answer.

7b:T60
